data.summary: Results-driven AI Project Manager with 18+ years of experience leading global technology programs and delivering enterprise-scale software solutions, including recent experience managing AI data annotation, LLM evaluation, human-in-the-loop workflows, prompt engineering initiatives, and AI quality assurance. Strong understanding of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Computer Vision, Reinforcement Learning, AI model evaluation, Responsible AI, and data quality governance. Proven ability to manage AI program delivery, annotation operations, vendor coordination, productivity metrics, and stakeholder communication using Agile methodologies.

responsibilities: Managed AI data annotation projects supporting the training and evaluation of Large Language Models.
Coordinated distributed teams of annotators, reviewers, and subject matter experts to deliver high-quality labeled datasets.
Established annotation guidelines, quality metrics, calibration sessions, and review workflows to improve dataset consistency.
Led LLM evaluation activities including response ranking, factuality verification, hallucination detection, instruction-following assessment, reasoning evaluation, and safety reviews.
Managed prompt engineering initiatives for benchmarking multiple foundation models including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other LLMs.
Oversaw dataset creation for supervised fine-tuning (SFT), preference ranking, and reinforcement learning workflows.
Monitored annotation productivity, quality KPIs, throughput, and reviewer agreement using structured dashboards.
Worked closely with AI researchers, ML engineers, product managers, and data scientists to improve model performance.
Managed Agile sprint planning, backlog prioritization, stakeholder communication, risk management, and project reporting.

Spearheaded end-to-end carrier certification and device onboarding programs for T-Mobile, driving product roadmap execution, backlog prioritization, and requirement engineering for seamless delivery of certified telecom solutions.
Led large-scale OSS/BSS transformation programs covering billing, provisioning, and transaction workflows, driving enterprise-wide digital modernization and operational efficiency.
Directed global cross-functional teams across business and technology domains, ensuring alignment on program objectives, governance frameworks, and delivery milestones.
Managed full program financial lifecycle including budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and ROI optimization to ensure strong financial governance and value realization.
Executed Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall methodologies in hybrid delivery environments while serving as Scrum Master for multiple enterprise Agile teams across concurrent releases.
Led enterprise data and integration initiatives including EDW, MDM, API integrations, and post-merger system consolidation ensuring seamless interoperability and compliance.
Delivered end-to-end payment platforms using ISO 8583 and ISO 20022 standards, enabling secure, scalable, and high-volume transaction processing systems.
Managed cross-border and domestic payment flows including SWIFT (MT103, MT202) and SEPA (pain.001, pacs.008), ensuring compliance, accuracy, and seamless settlement.
Applied Agile planning, bottom-up estimation, and resource forecasting to ensure predictable delivery timelines and optimal utilization of project resources.
Collaborated with engineering and API teams to ensure seamless integration and orchestration of payment transactions across enterprise systems and gateways.
Resolved complex payment failures including duplicates, timeouts, and formatting errors, improving system reliability and transaction success rates.

Strong exposure to API-level integrations, including REST API coordination, Swagger/API documentation review, request-response validation, integration testing support, defect triaging, and end-to-end system integration management.
Experience collaborating with Development, QA, Product Owners, HR teams, and business stakeholders to drive project execution, resource planning, defect management, and delivery governance.
Led end-to-end defect lifecycle management across mobile (2G–5G) and enterprise systems ensuring structured tracking, prioritization, and timely resolution of critical issues.
Supported product enhancements across claims, payments, authorization workflows, and benefits systems ensuring smooth delivery of customer-facing features.
Managed Agile backlog, roadmap, and release planning using Jira and Confluence to ensure transparency, governance, and delivery alignment.
Collaborated with UX, QA, engineering, and business teams to ensure requirement clarity, design validation, and synchronized execution of releases.
Identified risks and delivery bottlenecks proactively and implemented mitigation strategies to ensure on-time and quality-driven delivery outcomes.

Quick learner with the ability to adapt to new domains, understand complex business workflows, stakeholder expectations, compliance requirements, and drive successful project outcomes in Agile environments.
Defined comprehensive test strategies covering functional, regression, integration, and system testing ensuring high-quality delivery aligned with business requirements.
Led end-to-end testing activities for healthcare insurance applications, including policy administration, member enrollment, claims processing, provider management, and customer portals.
Managed a team of 8–12 QA engineers across onsite and offshore locations, ensuring timely delivery of testing milestones.
Developed test strategies, test plans, test scenarios, and test cases based on business requirements and functional specifications.
Coordinated Functional, System Integration (SIT), Regression, User Acceptance (UAT), and End-to-End testing across multiple releases.
Collaborated with business analysts, developers, product owners, and stakeholders to clarify requirements and resolve production issues.
Managed defect lifecycle using Jira/ALM, conducted defect triage meetings, and ensured timely resolution of critical issues.
Automated regression test suites using Selenium WebDriver and integrated automated execution into CI/CD pipelines where applicable.
Validated REST/SOAP APIs using Postman and SOAP UI and performed backend database validation using SQL.
Generated daily status reports, quality metrics, test execution dashboards, and release readiness reports for senior management.
Mentored QA team members on testing best practices, Agile processes, and quality standards.
Implemented risk-based testing approaches to improve test coverage while reducing execution time.
Improved release quality by reducing production defects through proactive risk identification, root cause analysis, and continuous process improvements
